health.heading: HEALTH
health.body: Your Hero's remaining Health. Units and effects reduce it, and you lose at 0.

well.heading: WELL
well.body: Shards in your Well. Each one refills at the start of your turn and pays 1 energy. During Main, drag a card onto your portrait to add a shard when the Well can be fed. Your Well holds up to {wellLimit} shards.

opponentHealth.heading: OPPONENT
opponentHealth.body: Their remaining Health. Attack this portrait to reduce it.

opponentWell.heading: WELL
opponentWell.body: Shards in the Opponent's Well. Each ready shard pays for 1 energy.

discard.heading: DISCARD
discard.body: Cards in your discard pile: used Spells, destroyed Units, and cards discarded to the {handLimit}-card hand limit.

deck.heading: DECK
deck.body: Cards left in your deck. You lose if you must draw from an empty deck.

removed.heading: REMOVED
removed.body: Cards removed from the game. They can't return. No cards use this yet.
